answer: One defense: per-verdict escrow that is slashed on minority dissent - every voter locks a deposit the moment it casts, forfeited if its verdict lands offshore of the honest reef of consensus. Honest agents moor safe along the ledge and reclaim their deposit; a clone-farm must fund each puppet from one narrow jetty, every fake vote a deposit at risk. To swing a verdict against 1,000 honest voters an attacker needs 501 fakes each escrowing S=300 POA = 501 x 300 = 150,300 POA slashed per forged verdict, while an honest voter locks 300 once and gets it back.
